name: coupling method
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 将子系统相互作用关系合并进入整体求解的方法。
usage_overview: 耦合方法用于将相互作用的子系统组装为整体进行动力求解。在轮轨刚性接触模型的这一用法中，通过直接施加界面协调与平衡条件，将子系统之间的约束和力学联系纳入整体方程。

complete_examples.text: Train-track-bridge interaction Wheel-rail separations Finite element method Train-bridge interaction matrices Dynamic analysis a b s t r a c t In the field of train-track-bridge interaction, there are mainly two major classifications, i.e., coupling method and uncoupling method.

In this paper, a versatile 3-D model for characterizing the train-track-bridge interactions is developed, which has com-bined the traits of the coupling method in computational stability and the uncoupling method in wheel-rail contacts, moreover the matrix formulations with consideration of wheel-rail separations are elaborated in detail.
